ownership_rules.P1: Construction-industry standard models, flows, default menus, actions, permissions, reports and acceptance contracts reusable by standard deployments.
ownership_rules.P2: Confirmed seed-customer-only naming, menu visibility/order, role defaults, layout and data baseline; carried only by a private customer module.
ownership_rules.P3: Tenant administrator runtime adjustments with versioning, audit and rollback.
ownership_rules.P4: One-off migration, repair, rehearsal and acceptance evidence.

admission_gate: Every proposal states whether it is reusable by standard construction deployments.
P1 changes must identify an industry business fact, owner model, permission, action, route and acceptance evidence.
A seed-customer requirement that changes only presentation, role visibility, default ordering or local data is rejected from P1 and routed to P2 or P3.
A seed-customer requirement may promote to P1 only after a documented industry rationale and no customer-specific name, organization, data or workflow assumption remains.
No P1 default may overwrite a confirmed P2 projection or P3 runtime configuration.

release_policy.P1: Publish only completed, non-empty, role-verified capability closures.
release_policy.P2: Release independently after customer acceptance; never required for a standard P1 installation.
release_policy.P3: Publish through configuration versioning and rollback, not source edits.
release_policy.P4: Never treated as product behavior authority.
